Hi! We started to formalize the 3 squares theorem on ItaLean as part of a project, and I would like to introduce a couple of lemmas missing on NumberTheory/LegendreSymbol/Basic.lean and JacobiSymbol.lean that we found useful. The PR is #37836

The ultimate goal would be to formalize the 3 squares theorem. Right now it compiles (made with the aid of aristotle, which was the whole point of the project), but we will try to make progressive small PRs towards it (needed a big golfing).
I've left a small comment, otherwise LGTM, thanks!
